rows.name: Jock Landale
rows.short: Landale (hip) is out for Sunday's game against Bucks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

rows.name: Kingston Flemings
rows.short: Flemings (back) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bucks.

rows.name: Mouhamed Gueye
rows.short: Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

rows.name: Asa Newell
rows.short: Newell (toe) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Chicago.

rows.name: Henri Veesaar
rows.short: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

rows.name: Neemias Queta
rows.short: Queta (rest) won't play in Monday's game against the Magic, Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site reports.

rows.name: Kon Knueppel
rows.short: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

rows.name: Dennis Schroder
rows.short: Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

rows.name: Jalen Smith
rows.short: Smith (undisclosed) went to the locker room in the fourth quarter of Monday's game against Cleveland, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

rows.name: Patrick Williams
rows.short: Williams (finger) has been ruled out for the remainder of Monday's game against Cleveland.

rows.name: Tobe Awaka
rows.short: Awaka (back) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Cavaliers.

rows.name: Caleb Wilson
rows.short: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

rows.name: Peyton Watson
rows.short: Watson left Monday's 126-115 win over Chicago due to a head injury and did not return.

rows.name: Jaylon Tyson
rows.short: Tyson (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Chicago.

rows.name: Evan Mobley
rows.short: Mobley will receive treatment and participate in rehab after the team confirmed a diagnosis of a right great toe sprain, and he'll be re-evaluated in the next 7-to-10 days.

rows.name: Sam Merrill
rows.short: Merrill (elbow) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Bulls.

rows.name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
rows.short: Tomlin is set to miss several weeks with a lower back stress reaction, Chris Fedor of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

rows.name: Max Christie
rows.short: Christie (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Celtics.

rows.name: Santi Aldama
rows.short: Aldama (ankle) is out for Sunday's game against the Celtics.

rows.name: Kyrie Irving
rows.short: Irving (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Celtics.

rows.name: Dereck Lively II
rows.short: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Thursday's game in Minnesota.

rows.name: Tarik Biberovic
rows.short: Biberovic (heel) is out for Thursday's game against Minnesota.

rows.name: Sergio de Larrea
rows.short: De Larrea (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's game at Minnesota.

rows.name: Julian Strawther
rows.short: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

rows.name: Taurean Prince
rows.short: Prince (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Spurs.

rows.name: Ronald Holland II
rows.short: Holland is out for Tuesday's game against San Antonio due to a left knee contusion.

rows.name: Isaiah Joe
rows.short: Joe (hip) is doubtful to play in Tuesday's game against the Spurs.

rows.name: Duncan Robinson
rows.short: Robinson (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Spurs.

rows.name: Jalen Duren
rows.short: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

rows.name: Stephen Curry
rows.short: Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

rows.name: Brandon Williams
rows.short: Williams (hamstring) will miss at least one week, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.

rows.name: Kristaps Porzingis
rows.short: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

rows.name: Moses Moody
rows.short: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

rows.name: Jimmy Butler III
rows.short: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

rows.name: Amen Thompson
rows.short: Thompson (knee) is out for Monday's game against the Heat.

rows.name: Clint Capela
rows.short: Capela (ankle) is out for Monday's game against the Heat.

rows.name: Steven Adams
rows.short: Adams (calf) is out for Monday's game against the Heat.

rows.name: Julian Phillips
rows.short: Phillips (illness) is available for Wednesday's game against Dallas.

rows.name: Marcus Smart
rows.short: Smart has been suspended three games for throwing a punch during Wednesday's matchup against Golden State, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

rows.name: Andrew Nembhard
rows.short: Nembhard (hip) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 76ers, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

rows.name: Tyrese Haliburton
rows.short: Head coach Rick Carlisle said Wednesday that Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least 10 more days, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.

rows.name: Johnny Furphy
rows.short: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

rows.name: Ben Sheppard
rows.short: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

rows.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
rows.short: Niederhauser (foot) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Jazz.

rows.name: Brandon Ingram
rows.short: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Friday's game against the Thunder, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

rows.name: Bradley Beal
rows.short: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

rows.name: Jordan Miller
rows.short: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

rows.name: Austin Reaves
rows.short: Reaves (heel) is out for Tuesday's game against the Hornets, Dave McMenamin of ESPN.com reports.

rows.name: Walker Kessler
rows.short: Walker (leg) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Hornets.

rows.name: Isaiah Stewart
rows.short: Stewart is out for Monday's game against the Wizards due to an illness.

rows.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
rows.short: Pippen (back) is progressing in his recovery but is still considered week-to-week.

rows.name: GG Jackson
rows.short: Jackson will undergo surgery to repair the broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot and is set to miss significant time.

rows.name: Ty Jerome
rows.short: Jerome (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Wizards.

rows.name: Richie Saunders
rows.short: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

rows.name: Bam Adebayo
rows.short: Adebayo (hip) has been ruled out for the remainder of Monday's game against the Rockets, Eric Nehm of The Athletic reports. He'll end with four points (1-3 FG, 0-1 3Pt, 2-4 FT), one rebound, two assists and two steals in 16 minutes.

rows.name: Nikola Jovic
rows.short: Jovic (illness) is out for Monday's game against Houston.

rows.name: Pelle Larsson
rows.short: Larsson won't play in Monday's game against the Rockets due to an illness, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

rows.name: Ryan Rollins
rows.short: Rollins (illness) is out for Sunday's game against the Hawks.

rows.name: Ousmane Dieng
rows.short: Dieng will undergo a procedure to repair a fractured left finger Monday, Justin Garcia of the Milwaukee Bucks Radio Network reports.

rows.name: Jaylen Clark
rows.short: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.

rows.name: Anthony Edwards
rows.short: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

rows.name: Donte DiVincenzo
rows.short: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

rows.name: Bryce McGowens
rows.short: McGowens (elbow) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Warriors.

rows.name: Bennedict Mathurin
rows.short: Mathurin (foot) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Warriors.

rows.name: Trey Murphy III
rows.short: Murphy (knees) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Golden State.

rows.name: Trendon Watford
rows.short: Watford (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Golden State.

rows.name: Dejounte Murray
rows.short: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

rows.name: Jaylin Williams
rows.short: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Kings.

rows.name: Thomas Sorber
rows.short: Sorber (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

rows.name: Cason Wallace
rows.short: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

rows.name: Chet Holmgren
rows.short: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

rows.name: Jalen Williams
rows.short: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

rows.name: Jonathan Isaac
rows.short: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Celtics.

rows.name: Noah Penda
rows.short: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

rows.name: Paolo Banchero
rows.short: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

rows.name: Izaiyah Nelson
rows.short: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

rows.name: Dominick Barlow
rows.short: Barlow (back) will be re-evaluated later in the week and is thought to be nearing his 2026-27 season debut, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.

rows.name: LeBron James
rows.short: James (back) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Nets.

rows.name: Adem Bona
rows.short: Bona (back) will be re-evaluated in approximately one week after seeing a specialist, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

rows.name: Ariel Hukporti
rows.short: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

rows.name: Mark Williams
rows.short: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

rows.name: Chris Youngblood
rows.short: Youngblood (foot) is out for Monday's game against the Timberwolves.

rows.name: Vit Krejci
rows.short: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

rows.name: Ja Morant
rows.short: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

rows.name: Shaedon Sharpe
rows.short: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

rows.name: Zach LaVine
rows.short: LaVine is out for Sunday's game against Oklahoma City due to illness, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.

rows.name: De'Andre Hunter
rows.short: Hunter (hip) is out for Sunday's game against the Thunder.

rows.name: Precious Achiuwa
rows.short: Achiuwa (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Thunder, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

rows.name: Maxime Raynaud
rows.short: Raynaud (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Thunder.

rows.name: Ben Simmons
rows.short: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

rows.name: Tobias Harris
rows.short: Harris (calf) is likely to be sidelined until early December, per Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio.

rows.name: Jayden Quaintance
rows.short: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

rows.name: Nate Bittle
rows.short: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Knicks, Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet.ca reports.

rows.name: Kevin McCullar Jr.
rows.short: McCullar signed a two-way contract with the Raptors on Thursday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

rows.name: Kawhi Leonard
rows.short: Head coach Darko Rajakovic said Wednesday that Leonard (knee) is doing individual on-court work and is progressing well, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.

rows.name: Jaxson Hayes
rows.short: Hayes (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Clippers.

rows.name: Lauri Markkanen
rows.short: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

rows.name: Jusuf Nurkic
rows.short: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.

rows.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
rows.short: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

rows.name: Tristan Vukcevic
rows.short: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Memphis.

rows.name: Reece Beekman
rows.short: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

rows.name: Justin Champagnie
rows.short: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

rows.name: Jamir Watkins
rows.short: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
